scope: Internal research validation only; not independent scientific certification or clinical qualification
prior_results_disclosure: Existing ORd Pharm predictions and early 20-cycle TP probes have already been examined. This is not a blind experiment. These criteria are frozen before new calculations, not retrospectively optimized to the held-out candidate.
assay_selection: Both new Roche Pharm and CiPA protocol estimates are eligible. Preserve both predictions as a protocol-sensitivity envelope, not a probabilistic confidence interval. Do not select a protocol based on prediction accuracy. Older published IC50 values remain disclosed separately; they are not pooled without complete compatible protocol evidence.
alternative_selection_basis: Barral et al overall benchmark E is lowest for TP under both assay protocols (76.6 and 83.8). Published Human endocardial equations, units and IKr/ICaL parameters are available. E alone is not qualification: even a zero-response predictor scores lower, as the authors note. No native parameter fitting permitted.
directionality: Every finite Dofetilide prediction must be positive; Nifedipine predictions must be negative. This tests observed mean direction, not significance where the observed confidence interval includes zero.
ordering: Dofetilide APD90 change must increase monotonically across all four published concentrations within each eligible assay protocol.
magnitude_and_uncertainty: At every concentration, the eligible protocol-sensitivity prediction range must intersect the two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval for the observed mean. Derive n by rounding (STD/SEM)^2, disclose it as derived, and require reconstruction agreement within 0.01. CI = mean +/- t.ppf(0.975,n-1)*SEM. This source-derived sampling-error criterion is an internal research gate, not a literature-endorsed clinical accuracy threshold. Assay spread is not a full model uncertainty interval; unresolved structural/exposure uncertainty precludes predictive qualification.
numerical: Fresh same-input replay must reproduce the stored native result. Independently use Radau with rtol=1e-8 and atol=1e-10 for one Dofetilide and one Nifedipine condition per selected model; absolute APD90-delta discrepancy must be <= 0.05 ms (the published observation sampling interval). Report last-cycle state discrepancy; do not call a fixed warmup proof of physiological steady state.
exposure_link: Retain accepted real PK-Sim two-scenario/two-subject Human run and its native Heart interstitial unbound curves. Map actual concentrations to the same Hill law under explicitly conditional plasma/assay/cardiac concentration equivalence. Do not fit PBPK to APD90. Benchmark bath concentrations remain nominal when measured concentrations are unavailable.
clinical_sanity: FDA label concentration-dependent AP/QTc prolongation supports direction only. No APD90-to-QTc conversion, QT fitting, clinical or safety inference.
decision: All scientific and numerical gates must pass for qualified_for_research_signal. Otherwise freeze exploratory_only; source/mapping/unit/numerical failures still refuse execution. Exploratory calculations cannot independently change candidate status.
stop: One established alternative maximum; no parameter tuning, new model families or held-out candidate inspection before engine freeze. Stop qualification regardless of outcome.
